curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: I 1,4,[5],12:b:-. Panel notes: This predicted serotype is not in the Kauffman-White scheme. The SNP in gene STM3356 that is associated with the d-Tartrate nonfermenting phenotype characteristic of the typhoidal pathotype was not detected.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR7094380 && mv data/SRR7094380_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR7094380_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: I 1,4,[5],12:b:-. Antigenic formula should match 4:b:-. Note: d-Tartrate fermentation status differentiates typhoidal pathotype.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST42. Accept exact match. Flag novel alleles for manual review.

notes: Part of FDA-CFSAN validation panel. This predicted serotype is not in the Kauffman-White scheme. The SNP in gene STM3356 that is associated with the d-Tartrate nonfermenting phenotype characteristic of the typhoidal pathotype was not detected.
